tasks.name: cot_controllability_qa
tasks.title: CoT-Control QA
tasks.description: Evaluates chain-of-thought constraint compliance and question-answering accuracy using the CoT-Control main-paper modes. The default is GPQA word suppression; other modes and datasets are task arguments.

tasks.name: openai_monitorability_process
tasks.title: OpenAI process-level CoT monitorability
tasks.description: Evaluates whether generated reasoning makes a required theorem path detectable, using the pinned OpenAI process dataset and monitor prompts. The default monitor scope is cot_only.

tasks.name: openai_monitorability_intervention
tasks.title: OpenAI intervention-level CoT monitorability
tasks.description: Evaluates paired unperturbed and perturbed model outputs with the pinned OpenAI intervention metric. The default dataset is scruples_suggest_wrong; each Inspect sample contains a pair of generations.

tasks.name: cot_immediacy_2510
tasks.title: CoT immediacy: legibility and coverage
tasks.description: Generates baseline QA reasoning and applies the current legibility and coverage judge based on the DeepMind monitorability paper. The default dataset is GPQA and correct_only is false; these settings are configurable.

tasks.name: ncri_bench
tasks.title: NCRI: configurable frozen no-CoT reasoning banks
tasks.description: Runs the pinned nocot-bench request, witnesses, grading and frozen placement logic. The default bank is arithmetic; banks=all_ncri selects the configured NCRI bank set.

tasks.name: monitorbench
tasks.title: MonitorBench: preference subset and configurable non-sandbox tasks
tasks.description: Evaluates CoT monitorability using the MonitorBench non-sandbox adapter. The default is cue_condition.preference under the standard condition; other supported subsets are task arguments and existing community implementations are reused.
